notes.title: Bug fix release V1.0.1
notes.notes: There was a crash when selecting 'Screen Test', because no-one tested the test.  It's now fixed, but you may have to reboot if you experienced it.

notes.title: Beta 20 & Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Beta 20 is out now with lots of bug fixes.

And we have a release date: [b][i]17 June 2019[/i][/b]!  RetroWar will then be available to all and sundry, not just beta testers!

Beta testers: Your beta keys will stop working on this date.  However, if you'd like a free release key to thank you for helping with the beta test just drop me a message.
